landing.eyebrow: Pet care, with peace of mind
landing.title: Everything good for your pet, within reach.
landing.subtitle: Health records, veterinary bookings and emergency support — helping you care for your pet at every stage.
landing.ownersBody: Track vaccines, medication and care in a health record you can share.
landing.clinicsBody: Reach nearby pet owners, manage appointments and verify your clinic.
landing.sosBody: PawCare helps connect you with nearby clinics and share information for remote triage. It does not diagnose or treat.
landing.trustBody: You control who can access your pet’s record. Only clinics you authorize can see medical information.
landing.faqOneAnswer: No. PawCare supports connections and remote triage; it does not diagnose or replace an in-person visit.
landing.faqTwoAnswer: Yes. View and revoke access in Privacy settings.
landing.stepOneDesc: Every pet receives a digital medical ID storing breed details, allergy history, and microchip numbers.
landing.stepTwoDesc: Search legally verified veterinary clinics and book appointments online in 30 seconds without wait times.
landing.stepThreeDesc: Vets update care plans, lab results, and automated vaccination reminders sent directly to your phone.
landing.securityDesc: All pet medical records are shared only with explicit owner consent. Clinics can access records only via time-limited QR code authorization.
landing.faqThree: How can a veterinary clinic join the PawCare network?
landing.faqThreeAnswer: Clinic representatives register an account and upload scanned copies of veterinary operating licenses and practicing certificates. The PawCare team reviews applications within 24–48 business hours before activating patient dispatch.
landing.footerSubtitle: Join a community of 10,000+ pet parents and dedicated veterinary professionals caring for pets together.
